outcome: Length of intensive care nursery admission
cohort: 150 singleton extreme preterm breech deliveries between 2005 and 2014 at a tertiary obstetric facility
finding: Caesarean section for singleton extreme preterm breech delivery is associated with reduced perinatal mortality, improved neonatal condition at delivery, and increased short-term maternal morbidity.
mod_finding: Caesarean section for singleton extreme preterm breech delivery is associated with reduced perinatal mortality, improved neonatal condition at delivery, and increased short-term maternal morbidity.
